records.text: Andrew Kolvet and Michael McCoy were seen in the West Wing with two women while a Charlie Kirk Show episode presented Kolvet as being elsewhere.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep ZzAT2xijKGQ)

appearances.snippet: I had received a couple of emails from people that follow and watch the show at the White House. And they said, hey, Candace, Andrew Kolvet, Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy) and a couple of women look like Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy)'s wife. They were in the West Wing. And, you know, we just thought that's kind of odd because Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) just presented as though he was live on the Charlie Kirk show doing a phone call with Kash Patel. But actually, he's here.

verification.notes: The episode attributes the West Wing sighting to private anonymous emails. Live searches confirmed the January 29 Charlie Kirk Show episode existed but found no independent public evidence placing Andrew Kolvet and Michael McCoy with two women in the West Wing or proving the presentation conflict. Private-source claim remains unverifiable.
